sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Fort Custer Recreation Area campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2026-12-10, 2027-01-14, 2027-03-11, 2027-04-15, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: Booking site: 145 20/30-amp sites $32 and 72 50-amp sites $37 through April 2027 (the DNR's 2026 table gives the same), rising to $34 / $39 from May 2027 (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike). The DNR table also lists semi-modern rates of $27 / $32. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($32 / $37 on 2026-10-27, 2026-12-10, 2027-01-14, 03-11 and 04-15; $34 / $39 on 2027-05-18, 07-13, 09-21) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Fort Custer Campground: 50-amp $37, 20/30-amp $32, semi-modern $32 / $27) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortcuster ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: midnrreservations.com site attributes (145 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps', 72 sites '20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps'; all 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortcuster (tag 'Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 219 sites in two sections (1-110 and 111-219). The booking site lists 217: 145 20/30-amp and 72 50-amp; allowed lengths run 20-50 ft, two sites are listed for trailers/RVs 'over 50'', and 17 take tents only.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortcuster ('Number of sites: 219') + midnrreservations.com resources (maps '1-110' and '111-219'; allowed equipment per site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Two-lane sanitation station with potable water between the two campground loops; registered campers only. Modern restrooms open year-round.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortcuster (campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station', 'Concession or store'; 'The park's sanitation station, which includes potable water and two lanes, is located between the two modern campground loops'; 'unable to offer sanitation station access to non-registered campers'; 'modern restrooms are open year-round'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortcuster (Fort Custer Modern Campground: 'Winter camping is available, and modern restrooms are open year-round') + DNR rates table (Fort Custer Campground reservable Year-round), read 2026-10-25

values.note: DNR table: sites 1-110 are reservable April 22 - Nov. 30; in the winter months reservable Thursday through Saturday.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fortcuster ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates ('Sites 1-110 are reservable April 22 - Nov 30. During winter months, reservable Thurs thru Sat.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground in Fort Custer State Recreation Area between Battle Creek and Kalamazoo: spacious, well-shaded sites in two loops near Eagle Lake (buoyed swim area, beach house with kayak/canoe rentals) and 40+ miles of trails. Former WWII Army training ground; the DNR warns explosive hazards may remain (Recognize, Retreat, Report). --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: confirmed 219 sites, 50-amp (72 sites) / 20-30-amp, electric only, year-round season, reservable on MiDNRReservations; max_rig_ft 45 -> 50 (two sites listed 'over 50''). Fees 27-37 (2026 table incl. semi-modern) -> 32-39 (booking site, 2027: $32/$37 through April, $34/$39 from May). Added showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station with water/store, the sites 1-110 winter booking rule. Phone matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
